reviews.text: This is really soothing, I have eczema and rosacea and it really calms my skin, I use it on my hands as well when my skin is really irritated and it helps soothe my skin.

reviews.text: Great product! I choose this product over others as it is acne-safe. It’s truly this color and it pumps neatly, with a wide, short bottle. You actually don’t need a big pump. I will buy it again! My skin feels so soft and it gives a subtle glow certainly. The bottle wasn’t entirely full, which was my only wish 🤭

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI PDRN Spirulina Soothing Repair Serum 50ml
